mara (Design): quick accessibility check on the Insights table: keyboard focus looks lost when you arrow between virtualized rows. noticed on Safari/VoiceOver and Chrome/NVDA. screenshot + recording: https://img.redwood/insights/rows.mp4 :mag: leo (Frontend): is this the large results table with column headers sticky? virtualized list uses aria-rowcount + aria-rowindex but we might be missing focusable elements inside each row. mara (Design): exactly. when you tab into the table it announces "table 0x..." and then rows, but pressing down arrow moves the visual highlight but VoiceOver still reads the previous row. anya (A11y): probable cause: managed focus isn't moving to a focusable DOM node when virtualization swaps rows. SRs rely on a real focusable element. If you're using role=\"row\" on divs and moving a CSS class for highlight, screen reader won't follow. We should ensure at least one focusable element per row (e.g., a hidden button with aria-label) and move focus programmatically. leo (Frontend): current pattern: ```html
{{model}}
{{latency}}
``` leo (Frontend): virtualization reuses DOM nodes so row DOM index changes, which confuses `aria-rowindex` updates for some SRs. anya (A11y): two fixes: 1) maintain a focusable element for the currently focused row and call `.focus()` when arrowing; 2) set `aria-live=\"polite\"` on a small SR-only announcer that reports "Row X of Y, selected" when focus changes. This avoids depending solely on aria-rowindex. jia (QA): adding: when we programmatically focus, make sure focus ring is visible in both light/dark and when user has reduced motion/high contrast settings. We had a failing case where focus ring was subtle on a dark striped row. mara (Design): i prefer an outline instead of box-shadow for better contrast. can we use a 3px outline with a neutral accent? leo (Frontend): propose CSS: ```css .table-row:focus-within { outline: 3px solid var(--accent-500); outline-offset: -2px; } .table-row[aria-selected=\"true\"] { background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(99,102,241,0.06), transparent); } ``` anya (A11y): accent color needs to meet 3:1 against the row bg for focus ring per WCAG focus contrast guidance. test against striped rows (#0f1720 and #10151a) in dark theme. leo (Frontend): noted. will pick var(--accent-500) that passes. Also for programmatic focus snippet: ```js function focusRow(idx) { const row = document.querySelector(`[data-index=\"${idx}\"]`); const anchor = row.querySelector('.row-focus-anchor'); anchor.focus(); announcer.textContent = `Row ${idx + 1} of ${rowCount}, selected`; } ``` leo (Frontend): add `role=\"grid\" aria-rowcount=\"${rowCount}\" aria-colcount=\"${colCount}\"` on the container. keep `role=\"row\"` and `role=\"gridcell\"` for cells. anya (A11y): also ensure header cells use `role=\"columnheader\"` and have `aria-sort` when sortable. For sortable columns keep the sort button as the interactive element inside the header, not the whole header cell to avoid accidental activation. jia (QA): file test matrix: VoiceOver macOS, NVDA+Firefox, JAWS+Edge, ChromeVox. Tests: arrow navigation (up/down) follows visual highlight; when filter changes, SR announces new result count; focus ring visible in high-contrast mode; virtualization reordering doesn't cause stale reading. ci-bot: accessibility-lint result: warn table-virtual-focus (severity: medium), announce-result-count (severity: low). https://ci.redwood/a11y/2281234567 mara (Design): small copy tweak: announcer should say "Showing N results" instead of "N results". less abrupt. anya (A11y): good call. message should be concise: `Showing ${n} results for ${query || 'all models'}`. For screen reader only region: `
`. Debounce updates so it doesn't read on every keystroke. leo (Frontend): will implement programmatic focus, SR announcer with 500ms debounce, accessible header buttons, and adjust CSS for outline contrast. estimate 3 dev hours + 2 QA. jia (QA): i'll add accessibility steps to the regression board. If you post the preview link i'll run the passes. leo (Frontend): PR opened: https://git.redwood/pr/7921 (WIP) ci-bot: deploy preview -> https://deploy-preview.redwood/7921 (includes focus anchor + announcer) anya (A11y): will run VoiceOver + NVDA checks on the preview tomorrow morning. please tag me on the PR for screen reader steps. mara (Design): thanks team 44aa leo (Frontend): closing once merged.
